other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Odisha
Must belong to the economically weaker section
Must be residing in a kutcha house
Must not own any pucca house in the state
Must be located in one of the 36 mining‑affected blocks listed in the scheme document
Households previously sanctioned a house under any Rural Housing scheme or already living in a pucca house are excluded
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance (up to ₹1,30,000) for construction of pucca houses for eligible kutcha‑house households in mining‑affected rural blocks of Odisha.
documents_required: Geo‑tagged photographs of the beneficiary’s kutcha house
Geo‑tagged photographs of the proposed construction site
